clarification: The frozen V5 design established the ten primary configurations, candidate-pool construction, blinded labelling, and one-time evaluation boundary before candidate labels were inspected.
The metric family P, Recall, and NDCG at 3, 5, and 10 plus truncated MRR at 10 was agreed before this evaluation was executed, after the labels had been frozen.

The exact primary endpoint, eleven controlled contrasts, bootstrap details, and exact-score tie formulas were defined in the hashed one-time evaluation script before numerical results were computed, but were not formally preregistered in the frozen design before labels and internal retrieval provenance were unblinded.

Accordingly, the phrase 'Predeclared controlled gene-level deltas' in the original evaluation manifest should be read as 'controlled gene-level deltas defined in the one-time evaluation script before computation', not as formal pre-unblinding preregistration.
reporting_rule: Do not describe the exact endpoint and contrast plan as formally preregistered before unblinding. If V5 results motivate configuration selection or modification, describe V5 as development or model-selection evidence and use a new untouched holdout for confirmation.
